name: dv1-delivery-dark
js: (async () => { const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const click=(sel,txt)=>{ const el=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find(x=>(x.textContent||'').trim().includes(txt)); if(el){ el.click(); return true; } return false; }; for(let i=0;i<60 && !click('.histrow','#1032');i++) await wait(120); await wait(1600); for(let i=0;i<40 && !click('.ttab','Thread');i++) await wait(120); await wait(1800); const b=document.querySelector('.tmsgs'); if(b) b.scrollTop=b.scrollHeight; await wait(600); })()
